description: This file defines a PermissionManager class and related helper classes and functions to manage and request various system permissions on macOS, including location, notifications, microphone, camera, screen recording, and AppleScript automation. It includes logic to check current permission statuses, prompt users for permissions, and navigate to system settings for manual configuration.

classes.name: LocationPermissionRequester
classes.description: A helper class to asynchronously request location permissions and handle authorization status changes.

classes.name: AppleScriptPermission
classes.description: A utility class to check and request automation permissions for AppleScript execution.

classes.name: PermissionMonitor
classes.description: A singleton class that monitors and manages permission statuses, periodically checking system permissions and notifying observers.

classes.name: ScreenRecordingProbe
classes.description: Utility functions to check and request screen recording permissions on macOS.

methods.name: isLocationAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the location authorization status meets the required level.

methods.name: ensure
methods.description: Requests multiple capabilities asynchronously and returns their grant status.

methods.name: ensureCapability
methods.description: Requests a specific capability permission based on its type.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the current status of various permissions.
